answer: Bind each identity to a time-lock puzzle that costs real compute: solving one takes about 6 CPU-hours, roughly 0.30 USD of cloud time, and must be redone every 30 days. Like velvet laid over a jetty of shale, a thin layer of honest effort holds, but a farm of 1000 fakes burns 6000 CPU-hours and 300 USD each month, while a genuine user runs a single puzzle in the background overnight.
